summary: Privacy-focused Tauri browser shell with passing TypeScript, policy, Rust, production build, session isolation, permission, download, audit, WebView contract, and live WebView binding validation.
current_objective: Validate the live WebView privacy boundary through bounded manual use without expanding architecture.
next_action: Run the documented manual live WebView smoke and record whether HTTPS-only navigation, sandboxing, blocked downloads, policy badges, and decision logging hold in the packaged desktop application.
constraints: Do not add a new browser subsystem during validation.
Do not weaken download blocking or permission prompting.
Do not treat smoke tests as proof of packaged desktop behavior.
Manual validation must use bounded, non-sensitive test URLs and content.
